assets.title: Agora art review — 16 original environment and furniture sprites
assets.notes: Review-only original artwork, 2026-10-12. Runtime source rectangles and nearest-neighbour scaling in src/artReview/art.ts. No Stardew assets included. The avatar uses the review extension to REF-B; full prompts and scope are in art-src/review/generation.json.

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game prop sprite atlas for Agora, an original cozy pixel-art 2.5D game.
Generate one 1024x1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent background. EXACT regular 4 columns x 4 rows grid, each cell 256x256. No visible grid. Exactly ONE separate sprite centered in each cell, all entirely contained with at least 20px empty padding. Baseline y=232 within every cell. No text, no labels, no borders, no checkerboard.
Art: exceptionally beautiful hand-pixeled 16-bit life-simulation RPG assets, crisp pixel clusters, logical ~64px per sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor 4x. Selective colored dark outlines, restrained warm highlights at upper left, cool forest shadows, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing. Readable silhouette, exquisite deliberate texture, no uniform noise. Natural believable proportions, charming. Three-quarter FRONT VIEW facing camera south, visible top surfaces, symmetrical front-facing furniture, NOT diamond isometric. These will be upright cards in a 35-degree tilted 3D world.
Row 1 from left: (1) lush broad-crowned oak tree with rounded clustered leaves in sage olive and warm spring green, branched honey-brown trunk and visible roots; (2) tall elegant layered spruce pine in deep teal greens; (3) graceful palm tree with spreading fronds and textured trunk; (4) tropical jungle tree with rich emerald layered crown and hanging vines.
Row 2: (1) natural grey-blue boulder with angular faces, a little moss; (2) low clump of pink and cream wildflowers on green stems; (3) lush delicate fern plant; (4) two-armed desert cactus, olive green ribs and tiny warm flower.
Row 3: (1) closed wooden storage chest, honey oak, curved lid, dark iron straps and brass latch; (2) wooden carpenter workbench with vise and just a hammer; (3) wooden torch post with small bright amber flame; (4) short wooden fence section, two posts and two rails.
Row 4: (1) modern wooden office desk facing front, one dark teal monitor and keyboard on top, honest recognizable furniture; (2) matching teal upholstered office swivel chair, front view; (3) single wooden bed with cream pillow and navy-blue blanket seen three-quarter from foot; (4) wooden shipping bin with open top and reinforced corner bands.
Palette: warm ivory #f5e2b6, honey #c58d52, walnut #674735, darkest #293c39, green #698c48 #94af5b #395f42, slate #778e94, teal #386975, amber #eab95a. Add limited intermediate shades as needed. All 16 assets beautifully detailed and cohesive. Transparent everywhere outside each individual object. No ground patches or floating platform underneath, minimal contact shadow only. Original designs, not assets from any existing game.

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create a production character WALK ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, original cozy pixel-art RPG adult avatar, transparent background, exactly 1024x1024 pixels, regular 4 columns by 4 rows of 256x256 cells. Each cell contains the SAME person, full body, centered horizontally at x=128, feet baseline y=228. Every figure exactly the same scale, about 96px wide and 176px tall, with plenty of transparent padding. No text, no lines, no checkerboard.
Character: warm medium skin, short tousled chestnut hair, small kind face with pixel eyes, teal long-sleeve shirt/jacket with ochre collar, dark navy trousers, brown boots. Adult proportions with head around a quarter of body height, NO enormous chibi head, NO white sticker outline. Consistent outfit, colors, body and facial proportions in ALL cells.
EXACT order:
Row 1 all face DOWN toward viewer: column1 neutral standing; column2 left foot steps forward and right arm forward; column3 neutral standing; column4 right foot forward and left arm forward.
Row 2 all face LEFT, full left profile: col1 neutral; col2 left leg forward; col3 neutral; col4 right leg forward.
Row 3 all face RIGHT, full right profile: col1 neutral; col2 left leg forward; col3 neutral; col4 right leg forward.
Row 4 all face UP away from viewer showing back of hair, shirt and boots: col1 neutral; col2 left step; col3 neutral; col4 right step.
Art quality: exquisite deliberate 16-bit pixel art, logically 24px wide by 44px tall character, uniformly enlarged 4x nearest neighbor. Beautiful clustered shading, dark colored selective 1 logical pixel outline, warm top-left light, cool shaded fabric folds, readable hair locks, 4-shade material ramps. Hard pixel edges with no blur, no anti-aliasing, no smooth vector curves. Flat front-facing 3/4 RPG view, not diamond isometric. No floor patches, shadows, props, weapons, hats, white border or background. Original avatar for Agora.
